## Endpoints

### Data Read (5)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve details of a specific listing by ID.
- `GET /api/bxp/bundles` — Get available bundles for listings.
- `GET /api/bxp/v2/navigation-trees/default` — Fetch the default navigation tree.
- `GET /api/locations/popular` — Retrieve popular locations for listings.
- `GET /widgets/livechat/assets/i18n/start/en.json` — Get live chat translation data.

### Data Write (4)
- `POST /.well-known/private-aggregation/report-shared-storage` — Report shared storage data.

- `POST /xmfXF/wG/TL/-Mkw/yEwKhP9/uD9fD2b9E1X7wL/IhkYIg/D3/kiCERnAAkB` — Submit data (purpose unclear).

### Realtime (1)
- `POST /events` — Post events (likely listing updates).

### Config (4)
- `GET /_bm/get_params` — Retrieve parameters.
- `GET /api/config/event_house` — Get configuration for event houses.
- `GET /getconfig/sodar` — Get SODAR configuration.
- `GET /ng-public/versions.json` — Get the current application versions.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Olx In's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Olx In data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.olx.in (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Olx In frontend uses
